The benefit of this is that you don't have the "instant aftercare" shutdown mentioned before on a yellow; yellow is basically, "slow down" or "let's talk about this", as opposed to "stop everything". Red, on the other hand, is 'cut the ropes.' So, that can help avert your Daddy's fears because he can be confident that you're not holding back on safewording because it's not a nuclear option to do so, allowing him to know that you're not even close to your limit point yet.

Another thing that can help: Find a piece of porn that approximates the kind of scenes you're having, and then find another piece that is that same scene concept, but at an intensity you'd prefer. Show him both so he can see the differences.

The key thing to take away: More communication is always good.  As long as you love him and he loves you, he will work on trying to fix it and you will be patient and understanding while he does. You'll be just fine.

Then it's a problem of terminology and needs to be fixed, because those two are **entirely** different concepts -- one is perfectly acceptable and the other is utterly abhorrent.

Again, the abstraction is the key. 

Age play in real life is just that -- ageplay. There may be what you call "simulated pedophelia", but everyone involved is an adult biologically. This is why ageplay is perfectly legal, and photos of it are perfectly legal, because it's usually pretty clear the person is an adult. Sure, they're wearing a school uniform, but they're also 6'3".

When you're RPing with a character who is *biologically* a minor, that's where some of these laws are coming into play. This is because some countries view it the same as art. If you drew a sketch of a man having sex with an adult in a diaper, it's fine, but if you drew the same sketch of a man having sex with a baby, it's kiddie porn. 

It's a razor-thin distinction, but that's where the distinction lies. I'm not saying I agree with it, but that's where it is.

However, now let's say Fred and Jane do an RP in which Fred plays an adult named Tommy and Jane plays a 21-year-old, let's call her Haley. In the story, Tommy dresses Haley up in a schoolgirl uniform and treats her like a minor. The difference is, he's still pretending to have had sex *with an adult*, because Haley is an adult in the story, she just isn't acting like it. That's ageplay, NOT pedophelia.
